notes.headline_changes: 1.5.0 upload + serve pipeline unification. (1) Customer-facing fix for Basecamp 9925110293 — non-public uploads no longer 403 their own thumbnails. (2) Five new services consolidate the pipeline: Services\VariantSpec (canonical rel-path), Services\StorageRouter (driver routing), Services\MediaVariantWriter (single meta writer), Services\PosterService (sole owner of wpmediaverse/posters/ writes), Core\MediaUrl (long-promised read-side facade). (3) UploadService 1482 → 1211 lines, exits Known Debt. (4) ImageOptimizationService publish_webp/avif twins collapsed to one extension-parametrized method. (5) Migrator v15 heals legacy thumb_*_path meta for video/audio rows; cloud-aware probe ensures cloud customers' CDN URLs continue to resolve. (6) New journey audit/journeys/customer/02-media-upload-non-public.md owns the regression test. (7) .distignore tightened to match Gruntfile.js authority — wp-plugin-qa no longer scans non-shipped tooling files.
